notes: PDF has 6 pages; printed page numbers 1–5 start after the title page. Capability Results on page 3 say results are listed below, but pdftotext extracted no benchmark numbers (likely an image/table); card points to deepmind.com/models/evals-methodology/gemini-3-flash — those external numbers were not extracted. Safety scores are absolute percentage-point deltas vs Gemini 2.5 Flash, not absolute rates; Multilingual Safety is annotated non-egregious. Architecture, training data, known limitations, acceptable usage, safety policies, and risks/mitigations largely defer to the Gemini 3 Pro card. FSF assessment is inferred from Gemini 3 Pro Preview (no CCLs) rather than direct Flash testing. Red teaming is internal specialist teams, not named external testers. Seed maps Gemini 3 Flash to google/gemini-3-flash-preview.
